endorsements.name: Liang Liao
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-34635
endorsements.description: The Poll Maker WordPress plugin is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the mcount parameter found in the ~/admin/partials/settings/poll-maker-settings.php file which allows attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts, in versions up to and including 3.2.8.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)
